## Required libraries

```r
library(VGAM)      # rpareto(), rdagum()
library(moments)   # skewness(), kurtosis()
```

## Parameters for a given value of the index

The following functions return the parameter of each distribution that yields a given value of $T_0$ or $T_1$, using the closed forms on the page [Theil indices](theil-indices.qmd).

```r
# True Theil indices
T.lognormal <- function(sigma)       sigma^2 / 2
T.pareto    <- function(alpha, index) if (index == "T1")
  1 / (alpha - 1) - log(alpha / (alpha - 1)) else log(alpha / (alpha - 1)) - 1 / alpha
T.gamma     <- function(k, index) if (index == "T1")
  digamma(k) + 1 / k - log(k) else log(k) - digamma(k)

# Parameter giving a target value of the index
param.theil <- function(T, dist = c("lognormal", "pareto", "gamma"),
                        index = c("T0", "T1")) {
  dist  <- match.arg(dist)
  index <- match.arg(index)
  switch(dist,
    lognormal = sqrt(2 * T),
    pareto    = uniroot(function(a) T.pareto(a, index) - T, c(1 + 1e-6, 1e4))$root,
    gamma     = uniroot(function(k) T.gamma(k, index)  - T, c(1e-4, 1e5))$root)
}
```

## Samples with a given Theil index

```r
set.seed(123)
n <- 50
T <- 0.3

alpha <- param.theil(T, "pareto",    "T0")
sigma <- param.theil(T, "lognormal", "T0")
k     <- param.theil(T, "gamma",     "T0")

Y.Par <- rpareto(n, scale = 1, shape = alpha)
Y.Log <- rlnorm(n, meanlog = 5, sdlog = sigma)
Y.Gam <- rgamma(n, shape = k, scale = 1)

# Sample skewness: the key driver of the bias
sapply(list(Pareto = Y.Par, Lognormal = Y.Log, Gamma = Y.Gam), skewness)
```

## Monte Carlo estimate of the relative bias

```r
RB.theil <- function(T, n, R = 1000, dist = "pareto", index = "T0") {
  p   <- param.theil(T, dist, index)
  rdist <- switch(dist,
    lognormal = function() rlnorm(n, 0, p),
    pareto    = function() rpareto(n, scale = 1, shape = p),
    gamma     = function() rgamma(n, shape = p))
  est <- replicate(R, { y <- rdist(); if (index == "T1") T1.hat(y) else T0.hat(y) })
  100 * (mean(est) - T) / T
}

RB.theil(T = 0.5, n = 50, dist = "pareto", index = "T0")
```

The functions `T0.hat()` and `T1.hat()` are defined on the page [Theil indices](theil-indices.qmd).
